title: HeavenzFire Batch 8 - gyroid-inspired tight-binding toy model
model: single-particle tight-binding Hamiltonian with real symmetric nearest-neighbour hopping
interpretation: The result is model-specific. Gyroid-modulated hopping had a slightly higher peak target probability than the shuffled-weight control in this run, but lower than the uniform cubic model. Peak times differ.
limitations: Toy gyroid-inspired hopping modulation, not an atomistic gyroid material.
Closed single-particle system; no leads, disorder ensemble, interactions, or device noise.
Does not establish quantum advantage, topological protection, or real-device performance.
Classical CPU simulation; no physical quantum hardware used.
provenance: Captured from the Windows ZDH execution output for Batch 8 on 2026-10-17. See experiment source for the reproducible computation.
